sources.entry: Tuxera NTFS - Full read-write compatibility with NTFS-formatted drives on a Mac.

summary.name: Microsoft NTFS for Mac by Tuxera
summary.one_liner: A commercial add-on driver from Tuxera that gives macOS full read and write access to Windows NTFS-formatted external drives.
keywords: read write windows drives on mac
dual boot windows macos drive sharing
use_cases: Writing files to Windows-formatted USB drives from a Mac
Sharing an external drive between Windows PCs and Macs
Formatting, checking and repairing NTFS volumes on a Mac
Accessing NTFS data from a dual-boot or virtual machine setup
Moving large files faster between an NTFS external drive and a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Adds read and write support for Windows NTFS-formatted drives on a Mac, so users can open, edit, copy, move, or delete files on them. It states that all NTFS versions are supported and that it can create NTFS volumes and disk images and verify and repair them. It uses smart caching for faster transfers and automatically translates file names. It includes native extended attributes support and a companion app, Tuxera Disk Manager, for formatting, checking, and repairing NTFS drives. The page says it works with dual-boot and virtual machine setups.
notable: Claims to be the only NTFS driver on the market with NTFS extended attributes support
Companion Tuxera Disk Manager app for formatting, checking and repairing NTFS drives
Speed described as similar to native HFS+
Supports macOS releases from Mac OS X 10.4 Tiger through macOS 27 Golden Gate as listed on the page
caveats: Licensed per person (one person = one license), implying a paid product
Page does not state a price; the pricing field is inferred from the one-license-per-person licensing model
